Shortcuts

Keyboard shortcuts work when Boostune is active on the current tab.

Keyboard Shortcuts
Increase volume by 10% Alt + ↑
Decrease volume by 10% Alt + ↓
Reset volume to 100% Alt + Shift + 0

To change these shortcuts, visit chrome://extensions/shortcuts in Chrome or edge://extensions/shortcuts in Edge.

Privacy

Boostune is designed to be privacy-first. Here's exactly what it does and doesn't do.

  • ✓
    Audio is processed locally. Tab audio is captured by your browser, processed in the extension's offscreen document, and output to your speakers — entirely on your device.
  • ✓
    No audio is recorded or saved. Boostune does not write audio data to disk or memory beyond what the Web Audio API uses transiently for processing.
  • ✓
    No data leaves your browser. Boostune makes no network requests. No analytics, no telemetry, no cloud sync.
  • ✓
    No content scripts injected. Boostune does not inject scripts into websites. It uses only extension-provided browser APIs.
  • ✓
    Preferences stored locally. Your settings (volume defaults, remembered site volumes) are stored in chrome.storage.sync and may sync across your Chrome profile — but stay within Google's infrastructure and are not accessible to Boostune servers (there are none).

About

BOOSTUNE
Boost Every Tab  ·  v1.0.0
What is Boostune? Boostune is a browser extension that captures the audio output of individual browser tabs and processes it through a custom Web Audio API pipeline. You can independently boost or reduce the volume of each tab from 0% to 600%, with a Safe Boost limiter to reduce clipping.
Architecture Audio capture uses chrome.tabCapture. Processing runs in an Offscreen Document (AudioContext → GainNode → DynamicsCompressor → destination). The Service Worker coordinates session lifecycle. The popup is a pure UI layer.
Permissions Used
tabCapture — capture tab audio stream
offscreen — run AudioContext persistently
storage — save preferences and site volumes
tabs — read tab titles, favicons, audible state
activeTab — access current tab info on popup open
